parsed.title: Unlock Commenting
parsed.oneLiner: Allow non-signed-in users to post a single comment after playing a game.

newMechanic.name: One-Time Comment Post
newMechanic.description: Allows a guest user to bypass the mandatory sign-up wall to post exactly one comment by watching a rewarded ad.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: Comment sections thrive on volume; many users want to participate but churn at the sign-up gate.

parsed.trigger: User taps 'Sign Up to Post' or initiates a comment on s05
parsed.eligibility: Non-signed-in users on the Add Comment Page.

offer.title: Post This Comment
offer.body: Play a 15-second game with AOL News to post your comment without signing up.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: The offer is gated specifically to users who hit the sign-up wall. The main 'Sign Up to Post' call-to-action remains primary, and the reward is strictly limited to one post, incentivizing sign-up for long-term participation.
risks: Users may find the ad wall frustrating compared to a seamless sign-up.
One-off comments may be lower quality than member comments.

newScreens.change: Rewarded interstitial invitation for playing a mini-game to unlock posting.

newElements.change: Add a text button: 'Watch a quick game to post instead'

callouts.text: User must sign up to join the conversation.

storyboard.caption: Currently, commenting is blocked by a mandatory sign-up wall.

callouts.text: New: Option to unlock posting via an ad.

storyboard.caption: We add an alternative path: watch a game to post.

callouts.text: Offer: Post this comment for 15s of play.

storyboard.caption: The user opts in to the game.
